第一条: Article 1  This Law is formulated in accordance with the Constitution in order to prevent, curb and punish telecom and online fraud, to strengthen anti-fraud work, to protect the lawful rights and interests of citizens and organisations, and to safeguard social stability and national security.
第二条: Article 2  “Telecom and online fraud” in this Law means conduct that, for the purpose of unlawful possession, uses telecommunications network technology to defraud public or private property by remote, non-contact or similar means.
第三条:
Article 3  This Law applies to combating and governing telecom and online fraud carried out within the territory of the People’s Republic of China, or carried out abroad by citizens of the People’s Republic of China.

Where an organisation or individual outside the territory carries out telecom and online fraud directed at persons within the territory of the People’s Republic of China, or provides products, services or other assistance to another in carrying out such fraud directed at persons within the territory, the matter shall be dealt with and liability pursued in accordance with the relevant provisions of this Law.
第四条: Article 4  Anti-fraud work shall be people-centred and shall coordinate development and security; it shall adhere to a systems approach and to rule-of-law thinking, with emphasis on addressing fraud at source and on comprehensive governance; it shall adhere to joint management and mass prevention, implementing in full the measures for suppression, prevention, administration and control and strengthening public publicity, education and prevention; and it shall adhere to precise prevention and control, so as to safeguard normal production and business activities and the convenience of people’s lives.
第五条:
Article 5  Anti-fraud work shall be conducted in accordance with law and shall protect the lawful rights and interests of citizens and organisations.

The relevant departments, entities and individuals shall keep confidential any state secrets, commercial secrets, personal privacy and personal information that come to their knowledge in the course of anti-fraud work.
第六条:
Article 6  The State Council shall establish an anti-fraud working mechanism to provide overall coordination of work to combat and govern such fraud.

Local people’s governments at each level shall organise and lead anti-fraud work within their administrative areas, determine the objectives, tasks and working mechanisms for such work, and carry out comprehensive governance.

Public security organs take the lead in anti-fraud work, and the relevant departments for finance, telecommunications, cyberspace administration, market regulation and other fields perform their regulatory responsibilities in accordance with their duties and are responsible for anti-fraud work in their own industry or field.

The people’s courts and people’s procuratorates shall give play to their adjudicative and procuratorial functions and prevent and punish telecom and online fraud in accordance with law.

Telecommunications business operators, banking financial institutions, non-bank payment institutions and internet service providers bear responsibility for risk prevention and control; they shall establish internal control mechanisms and security responsibility systems for anti-fraud work, and shall strengthen fraud-risk security assessment of new business.
第七条: Article 7  The relevant departments and entities shall cooperate closely in anti-fraud work, achieving cross-industry and cross-regional coordination and rapid joint action, and shall strengthen the building of specialist teams so as to combat and govern telecom and online fraud effectively.
第八条:
Article 8  People’s governments at each level and the relevant departments shall strengthen anti-fraud publicity, popularise the relevant law and knowledge, and raise public awareness of, and ability to recognise, the various methods of telecom and online fraud.

The relevant departments for education administration, market regulation and civil affairs, and villagers’ and residents’ committees, shall strengthen publicity and education for groups such as older people and young people, having regard to the distribution and other characteristics of the victims of telecom and online fraud, shall make anti-fraud publicity and education more targeted and precise, and shall carry out activities taking such publicity and education into schools, enterprises, communities, rural areas and households.

Every entity shall strengthen its internal work to guard against telecom and online fraud and shall provide its staff with education on such prevention; individuals shall strengthen their own awareness of guarding against such fraud. Entities and individuals shall assist and cooperate with the relevant departments in carrying out anti-fraud work in accordance with this Law.
